competencyTags: misconception:last count word not linked to total

prompt.en: Cardinality Compare checkpoint: One card has 10 dots. Another card has 13 dots. How many dots are on the card that has more?
prompt.zh: 幼兒園數數與數量練習：一張卡有 10 個點，另一張卡有 13 個點。點較多的一張卡有多少個點？
prompt.zhHans: 幼儿园数数与数量练习：一张卡有 10 个点，另一张卡有 13 个点。点较多的一张卡有多少个点？

explanation.en: 13 is greater than 10, so the card with more has 13 dots.
explanation.zh: 13 大於 10，所以點較多的一張卡有 13 個點。
explanation.zhHans: 13 大于 10，所以点较多的一张卡有 13 个点。

solutionSteps: Compare 10 and 13; the greater number is 13, so the card with more has 13 dots.

questions.independentSolution: Compare 10 and 13; the greater number is 13, so the card with more has 13 dots.

prompt.en: Fraction Decimal checkpoint: A rectangle is split into 5 equal parts. 3 parts are shaded. What fraction is shaded?
